mapper.select: SELECT transfer_id, tenant_id, from_warehouse_id, to_warehouse_id, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM wms_transfer_order WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (from_warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} OR to_warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_transfer_order_line SET seller_sku = #{sellerSku}, transfer_quantity = #{transferQuantity}, received_quantity = #{receivedQuantity}, unit_cost = #{unitCost}, batch_no = #{batchNo} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND line_id = #{lineId}
mapper.select: SELECT line_id, tenant_id, transfer_id, seller_sku, transfer_quantity, received_quantity, unit_cost, batch_no FROM wms_transfer_order_line WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND transfer_id = #{transferId} ORDER BY line_id
